answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and register identities in a Semaphore tree, then evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed shares form a trellis of rate-limit proofs. A valid message carries a nullifier and share; honest use remains unlinkable, but duplicate messaging creates an algebraic collision. Shamir secret sharing then reconstructs the agent’s private key, making the violation an echo across the spiral of checks and triggering instantaneous collateral slashing.
